default:
Luaward Official AI Plugin

Luau script protection, licensing, and live Roblox in-game and Studio QA for Claude, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Codex, and MCP agents

Protect, build, test in a live Roblox session, inspect GUI and remotes, and sync with Roblox Studio directly from your coding agent.

## Overview The **Luaward** plugin connects Antigravity to your Luaward workspace over Luaward's hosted MCP server (`https://luaward.com/mcp`) using OAuth 2.1, and pairs two specialized skills (`luaward-workspace` and `luaward-live-qa`) plus workspace safety rules (`rules/AGENTS.md`). - **Workspace & Protection**: create and deploy protected Luau scripts (`fast`, `balanced`, `max`), stage drafts (`publish: false`), test builds, promote/roll back live versions (`promote_build`), manage license keys/HWID resets, and resolve player error reports. - **Live Game QA & Profiling**: inspect connected sessions, run isolated tests (`run_and_collect` with `clean_env` and resource cleanup via `cleanup_run`), profile FPS/memory (`benchmark_session`), inspect UI handles (`gui_snapshot`), and interact safely (`ui_controls`). - **Windows Desktop & Visual QA (Optional Hybrid Bridge)**: combine Luaward Cloud (`https://luaward.com/mcp`) and local `file_path` script loading with `@luaward/mcp` (`npx -y @luaward/mcp`) on Windows for hardware Win32 input (`os_click`, `desktop_mouse`, `desktop_keyboard`), OS PNG screenshots and visual diffs (`desktop_screenshot`, `compare_screens`), window/process control (`desktop_launch`, `desktop_window`, `desktop_ui_tree`). ## Quick start ### 1. Install the plugin From Antigravity **Customizations -> Plugins** (once published to the Marketplace), find **Luaward** and click **Install**. Or install directly from a local checkout: ```sh agy plugin validate . agy plugin install . ``` ### 2. Connect your Luaward account (OAuth 2.1) **Installing the plugin enables its skills and rules. Sign in to unlock Luaward Cloud MCP tools.** 1. Open **Agent settings -> Customizations**. 2. Click **Authenticate** next to the `luaward` MCP server entry in the **Luaward** plugin. 3. Sign in to your Luaward account in the browser and authorize your workspace. 4. Copy the authorization code if prompted, paste it into the authentication field in settings, and click **Submit**. Antigravity refreshes OAuth access tokens automatically. You can also generate a personal scoped MCP token (`lwm_...`) anytime at [dash.luaward.com/dashboard/ai](https://dash.luaward.com/dashboard/ai). ### 3. Optional: Enable Windows Desktop Bridge (`@luaward/mcp`) If you develop on Windows and want hardware Win32 mouse/keyboard automation, window management, OS screenshots, and local `file_path` script loading, add `@luaward/mcp` to your local MCP config alongside your standalone Potassium or Roblox Studio MCP configs (if used): ```json { "mcpServers": { "luaward": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@luaward/mcp@0.2.8"], "env": { "LUAWARD_MCP_TOKEN": "lwm_YOUR_48_HEX_TOKEN" } } } } ``` ### 4. Try it out Ask Antigravity: > List my Luaward projects, scripts, and connected live Roblox game sessions. Or try: - Run a live in-game QA check on my Roblox session and inspect GUI controls and remotes. - Diff my open Roblox Studio place against the live game and mirror missing remotes or GUI. - Deploy a draft build from my script, test it in-game, and promote it when clean. ## Troubleshooting ### Installed, but Luaward tools do not appear Check that the **Luaward** plugin is enabled in **Agent settings -> Customizations**, then click **Authenticate** on the `luaward` MCP server entry (or check that your workspace has an active session/token). ### Browser OAuth finished, but Antigravity is still waiting Copy the authorization code shown after approving access on `luaward.com/oauth`, paste it into the authentication prompt inside Antigravity settings, and click **Submit**. ### Live game tools return `"no game is connected"` Connect a live game session from the Luaward Dashboard ("Test in game"), or run the workspace pair snippet inside your connected Roblox executor session. ## Links & Development - **Workspace MCP Docs**: [luaward.com/docs/ai-tools/workspace-mcp](https://luaward.com/docs/ai-tools/workspace-mcp) - **NPM Hybrid Bridge (`@luaward/mcp`)**: [npmjs.com/package/@luaward/mcp](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@luaward/mcp) - **Release & Marketplace Guide**: [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)
